Short title and commencement

ACT XXI OF 2011
ACT XXI OF 2011
ZULFIKARABAD DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Zulfikarabad Development
Authority Act, 2010
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
7th July, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-18/2011, dated 6-7-2011.---The
Zulfikarabad Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been passed by
the Provincial of Sindh on 8th June, 2011 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 28th June,
2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Zulfikarabad Development Authority
Act, 2010, in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Zulfikarabad Development
Authority (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act No.XXI of 2010

No.PAS/Legis-B-18/2011, dated 6-7-2011.---The
Zulfikarabad Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been passed by

assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 28th June,
2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Zulfikarabad Development Authority
Act, 2010, in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act No.XXI of 2010.---In
the Zulfikarabad Development Authority Act, 2010, in section 5, for subsection
(1), the following shall be substituted:--
"(1) The Authority shall perform the functions and
exercise the powers through Governing Body which shall consist
of--
(a)
Chief
Minister
Chairman
(b)
Three
Members of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh to be
nominated by Government
Members
(c)
Chief
Secretary
Member
(d)
Additional
Chief Secretary, Planning and Development
Member
(e)
Senior
Member, Board of Revenue
Member
(f)
Secretary
Finance
Member
(g)
Secretary
Local Government
Member
(h)
Member Land Utilization, Board of Revenue
Member
(i)
Managing
Director
Member
(j)
Chief Executive
Officer Sindh
Land Management and Development Company
Member
(1-a) The Chief Minister
may in his discretion appoint any member or person as Vice Chairman of the
Governing Body who shall, inter alia, chair the
meetings of the Governing Body in the absence of the Chief Minister.
(1-b) The
Chief Minister may in his discretion appoint any member or person as Secretary
of the Governing Body.".
